messages:
Maria: Heads up — we've been getting customer confusion around our 429/503 behavior. Can we align on a taxonomy for routing/quota/degrade signals before the console rollouts?
Ajay: Which flows are causing the most confusion?
Maria: Three main buckets: 1) per-tenant quota throttle (client hit limit) -> currently 429. 2) graceful degrade when model capacity is constrained but we return fallback/partial -> currently 200 w/ body explaining degraded quality. 3) infra/unreachable/backpressure -> 503/5xx. Also routing fallback where we route to cheaper model (still 200) but customers see lower quality.
Kev: +1. I'd prefer explicit signals, not overload 200 for both normal success and degrade. Clients can't reliably behave differently.
Elaine: Product: customers want clear retry vs fallback guidance. The console needs a single banner mapping for "Your calls are degraded" vs "Rate limited" vs "Service outage."
Samir: Telemetry-wise we need a stable tag across the stack: `route.reason` and `error.bucket` in traces. Also surface a client header so SDKs can make deterministic decisions.
Maria: Proposal for machine-readable headers:
```
X-Redwood-Error-Type: quota|degrade|infrastructure|upstream
X-Redwood-Client-Action: retry|backoff|no-retry|fallback
Retry-After: 30
X-Redwood-Degrade-Level: soft|hard
```
These accompany status codes; e.g. a soft degrade => `200 + X-Redwood-Error-Type: degrade + X-Redwood-Client-Action: fallback`.
Ajay: SDK concern: if degrade is 200, SDKs treating any 200 as success will hide it. We need SDK changes to surface `X-Redwood-Client-Action` and emit events. Also clarify idempotency and retries for 429 vs 503.
Kev: On status codes: keep 429 for client quota. Use 503 for capacity/unavailable. Avoid introducing new 2xx codes. Prefer 200 + header for safe fallback where we must return text. We should document retry semantics explicitly: 429 -> retry-after / exponential backoff, 503 -> immediate client fallback + alert.
Elaine: Console copy ideas:
- Quota: "Request rate limit exceeded. Wait {{Retry-After}}s or request a quota increase."
- Degraded: "We returned a lower-quality response to preserve availability — consider retrying or switching model." :warning:
Samir: Telemetry metric names: `redwood.responses.error_type`, tag `degrade_level`, and a counter `redwood.client_action.fallback` for sample rate.
deploy-bot: deploy success to canary: inference-router v3.2.1 -> rollout 5% :rocket: 
Maria: Action items: 1) Ajay - SDK expose `X-Redwood-Client-Action` + event hook. 2) Kev - update router to attach headers and map codes. 3) Samir - add metrics and span tags. 4) Elaine - console banner copy + runbook. I'll PR the RFC draft today.
Ajay: ack. I'll draft SDK PR and add tests for idempotency.
Kev: Ack, will add mapping config and canary flag.
Elaine: I'll draft console strings and put in #product-review.
Samir: I'll add telemetry dashboards and a simple anomaly alert for `redwood.responses.error_type:degrade`.
Maria: Thanks all — goal is no user confusion when we flip canary next week. :thumbsup:
